note: ANZ's fees and charges for customer banking services in Kiribati (effective 23 September 2026): the Access Everyday Account lists no monthly account fee (the cheque accounts' is 3 dollars), only ATM and staff-assisted transaction fees, which aren't modelled.

sources.title: ANZ Fees and Charges, Customer Banking Services Kiribati (effective 23 September 2026)
sources.said: Customer Banking Services Kiribati Effective 23 September 2026 ... Access Everyday Account ... ATM withdrawal fee $0.25 per ... Staff assisted transaction fee1 $2.00 per ... Business and Personal Cheque Accounts ... Monthly account fee $3.00
